training_contract: Only train/086, train/110 and lidar/ may condition or select a prior; diagnostic/ and diagnostic sheet rows are excluded from BUILD and candidate selection.

frames.canonical_axes: actor x=longitudinal forward, y=left, z=up; centered OBB; metres
frames.mask480_to_native_pixel_convention: continuous u_native=4*u_mask; pixel centers u_native=4*(u_mask+0.5); nearest mask expansion, no new boundary truth
frames.camera_axes: Waymo camera native X forward, Y left, Z up; normalized image x=-Y/X, y=-Z/X

tri_state_values.0: outside fixed OBB potential / target background
tri_state_values.128: unknown within potential, including occluded and uncertain edges

mask_contract.potential: Brown projected fixed OBB, 33 samples per edge, convex hull + 4 native pixel guard; union observed approximate mask. This is not amodal silhouette GT.
mask_contract.safe_visible: a20 and native21 agreement; erode one 480-mask pixel; exclude one-pixel dilated a9/native10; RGB/alpha outside core forced to zero
mask_contract.occluder: a9 mask within crop; its overlap with target potential remains unknown
mask_contract.resolution: 480x320 source masks are approximate; 1920x1280 masks are nearest expansion, not native-resolution annotation

lidar.axes: right-handed actor local: x=vehicle longitudinal forward, y=left, z=up; centered fixed OBB
lidar.source_lidar_format: <f4 N x 6; first three columns are same-frame ego xyz metres; other source columns are preserved only by row index
lidar.transform: p_actor = inverse(world_from_actor) @ ego_world @ p_ego, column-vector SE3; NumPy row-vector implementation equivalent
lidar.boundary_filter: abs(p_actor)<=dimensions/2+1e-6; subtract a9 OBB expanded 0.05m per axis. Geometric membership, not semantic instance ground truth.
lidar.no_camera_mask_filter: Camera a9 projection does not decide LiDAR ownership: genuine a20 returns may project behind the occluder. a9 3D OBB guard is used.
lidar.dedup_policy: 2cm canonical voxels; representative is an actual measured point nearest per-voxel measured mean; all originals and membership retained
